authentication.canonicalization: ASCII JSON with sorted keys and compact separators

deduplication.domain: the six accepted semantic records, retaining multiplicity before unique-key counting
deduplication.reconstructed_parent_ordered_key: ordered factor-major binary payload including header
deduplication.reconstructed_parent_unordered_key: lexicographically sorted complete-term binary payload including header
deduplication.reconstructed_source_pair_ordered_key: ordered pair of three-factor source terms

enumeration.compact_descriptor_semantics: slotX and slotY are the child slots assigned to formula outputs 0 and 1; slotZ/formula output 2 is the remaining member of {45,46,47}

fixed_child.construction: remove root slots 7 and 13; Plus variant 0 under ikj=(0,2,1); append outputs in formula order at child slots 45,46,47

implementation.runtime_guard_statement: generation requires the sage.all execution namespace and the Sage -- argv delimiter; this ordinary-runtime guard is not attestation against a malicious in-process caller able to forge globals
implementation.source_binding_statement: hashes report actual source-file bytes read at oracle start and again at report time; equality is required

inverse_method.assignment_semantics: assignment is the child-slot triple assigned respectively to formula outputs 0,1,2
inverse_method.parent_reconstruction: retain child slots 0..44 as survivors and insert the ordered reconstructed source pair at parent slots 7 and 13

compact_descriptor_streams.encoding: canonical ASCII [slotX,slotY,orientationIndex,variant] plus LF per descriptor; slotZ/formula output 2 is the remaining member of {45,46,47}

full_semantic_record_streams.encoding: one complete canonical JSON semantic record plus LF, in descriptor enumeration order
